profile.headline: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord...
profile.summary:
I have been fortunate enough to have a diverse background and learned a variety of skills along the way.
My educational background is in electrical engineering. I started my career with embedded systems writing code in C/C++. After joining Amazon, I developed a passion for software development in test and automation as an SDET where I built some awesome automation frameworks leveraging the scalability and power of AWS. I transitioned to work as an SDE with Alexa making some fun and cutting edge Alexa skills, fun and innovative game prototypes, and enabled HTML gaming for developers on Alexa devices. I then reinforced my skills in embedded systems, working on platform software for Prime Air delivery drones. I am currently working on a Java service to handle leave eligibility management for employees.

I am always looking to grow in leadership and technical expertise, keeping up to date with the latest innovative technologies, and exercise my creativity at work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
People Experience - Disability & Leave Systems
* Development on internal leave authority service to determine leave eligibility and entitlements
* Development on Event messaging system for changes in employee leave details

Prime Air
* Working on Drone Delivery platform software and logging system using C++
* Wrote interfaces and a Linux implementation for CAN and UDP messages for Cyphal

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Alexa Games Tech Team
* Enabled Web API capabilities for game developers on multi-modal Alexa devices

Alexa Games
* Designed and demonstrated innovative device prototypes to drive multi-modal engagement including smart home integration, children's story time, and smart motion

Alexa Lantern Team
* Developed Alexa skills including Uber, re:Invent, and Trivial Pursuit Tap 
* Developed proof of concept for a live video trivia game for Alexa

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Amazon Game Studios
* Projects/Teams: Sev Zero, Lumberyard, New World
* Created a game automation test framework for the Lumberyard engine 
* Developed and designed a scalable automated AWS based CI/CD Jenkins build system 
* Designed and implemented an automated, scalable, Windows game client load test system 
* Developed a telemetry collection service and framework and automated metrics collection 

Amazon Game Circle
* Created an Android automation framework using Robotium, Junit, and Jenkins for Kindle testing
* Developed and ran load tests and gremlin tests for Game Circle backend services 
* Automated network test scenarios using Netropy network emulation tool

positions.title: Software Engineer/Systems Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked with the JTRS team and MUOS on software defined radios
* Developed C/C++ software for Software Defined Radios (SDRs) for MUOS and Wideband Networking Waveforms
* Developed hardware automation using LabVIEW for the SDRs used in hardware verification

positions.title: Software Engineer Asc.
positions.description:
* Developed software for data routing hardware using C/C++ on Power PC and Intel x86 platforms
* Built and maintained Wind River Linux Kernel for the platform
positions.insights: Linux Server, Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) and +5 skills

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
* Verified documents and schematics for product and test fixtures
* Assembled test fixtures according to schematics, troubleshoot faulty test fixtures, and verified the test fixtures through the tool proof process
